title: Fetters of Destiny
next_chapter_hook: As Ye Qing's silhouette vanished into the Void Rift, the dragon roars from the Dragon Vein's depths grew increasingly distinct, and from the direction of the distant Tianqing Sect, a fierce sword intent pierced the heavens—that was Su Qingyao's aura, hurtling toward this location with startling speed.

text.content: The power fluctuation erupting from the depths of the Time-Space Rift manifested like a tangible Heavenly Might, freezing Chen Ji in place. This was no ordinary pressure, but a gaze transcending comprehension—as if the entire heavens and earth were staring at him, determined to strip away all his secrets, all his scheming, all the ambitions concealed beneath the facade of a "waste." He could even sense the Tianji Record Fragment trembling violently within his Mental Sea, while the aura of that remnant soul guardian fell completely silent at this moment, as if even Mo Xiansheng dared not meet that gaze.

The golden radiance emanating from the Dragon Vein's core was tainted into a sinister purple-black hue by that will's projection, like a tear in the celestial vault revealing the fathomless void behind it. Chen Ji's right hand hung suspended in mid-air, a mere three chi from the spiritual pearl containing the Dragon Vein's essence, yet unable to advance even an inch. His pupils reflected the gradually forming shape—a vertical eye, with countless scenes swirling within its depths, as if the fate of all things in existence was rotating within.

"At last... I have found you." The voice did not emanate from that vertical pupil, but resounded directly in the depths of Chen Ji's Mental Sea, carrying an ancient and distant resonance, "Inheritor of the Tianji Record... no, perhaps I should say, another fool willing to be a chess piece." Before the words finished, Chen Ji felt his Heavenly Fate Value draining at an incomprehensible speed—not the consumption of using his abilities, but being directly抽取 by that will, like countless tiny needles piercing into the depths of his Mental Sea, slowly汲取 his foundations.

Just as Chen Ji believed he would be completely devoured, a blade of jet-black demonic energy slashed toward that will's projection like a sword, severing the purple-black gaze. Amid the void's trembling, a figure strode out from the Dragon Vein's depths, surrounded by诡异的 blood-colored纹路, and on that frost-cold face there was now an uncommon resolve—it was Ye Qing. Her appearance caused that vertical pupil to slightly contract, as if assessing something.

dialogue.content: "Heavenly Eye... you've finally deigned to show yourself." Ye Qing's voice was cold as freezing ice, yet carried an unfamiliar mockery Chen Ji had never heard before, "Waiting so long, just wanting to witness this generation's Tianji Record inheritor with your own eyes? Now you've seen——" She tilted her head, her gaze intersecting with Chen Ji's, harboring complex emotions within, "His life is included in this Saintess's agreement."

text.content: Ye Qing stepped forward slowly, positioning herself between Chen Ji and that will's projection. Her figure was slender yet resolute, with crimson demonic energy forming a barrier around her that shielded the suffocating Heavenly Might outside. However, Chen Ji acutely sensed that her aura was fading visibly—the cost of that barrier clearly far exceeded her capacity. He wanted to speak but found his lips seemingly sealed by an invisible force, able only to watch helplessly as all this unfolded.

dialogue.content: "Supplementary clause, formally triggered." Ye Qing's voice was terrifyingly calm, yet carried an imperceptible tremor, "When this Saintess signed the alliance with this boy back then, I planted a chess piece in that agreement—if the Tianji Record inheritor faces direct elimination by Heavenly Will, as the other party to the agreement, I will automatically obtain the inheritance rights." She laughed coldly, "Do you think I don't know what you're scheming? Haven't all the Tianji Record inheritors throughout history been drained of their Heavenly Fate by you like this, eventually exhausted and dead?"

text.content: There was not the slightest emotional fluctuation in that vertical pupil; it merely rotated slowly, as if examining this奇异 combination of Ye Qing and Chen Ji. After a moment, an elderly yet majestic voice exploded in the void: "Interesting... the castoff of the Demonic Path Holy Sect, daring to sign a life-and-death agreement with the Tianji Record inheritor." The voice turned, carrying a playful tone, "Do you know—if he dies, you can indeed inherit that fragmented Heavenly Secrets—but can your foundation withstand it?"

Ye Qing's form slightly stiffened, and fine cracks appeared in that layer of blood-colored barrier. Chen Ji finally broke through the constraints, urgently grabbing her wrist—the sensation in his palm was ice-cold and piercing—not a normal body temperature, but the chill toxin after years of being eroded by some force. He instantly understood: Ye Qing's foundation had long been completely devoured by the restrictions on her body. She was never a genius among demonic saints, but a pitiful person used as a vessel.

dialogue.content: "So this is your true identity?" Chen Ji's voice was low and calm, yet beneath his eyes churned terrifying waves, "The castoff of the Demonic Path Holy Sect... another chess piece in the Heavenly Chess Game... from the very beginning, we were the same kind." He released his hand, stepping back, yet did not create distance; instead, he stood at Ye Qing's side, shoulder to shoulder with her as they faced that lofty will's projection, "Interesting, I thought I was the one scheming against you."

"You think I came to save you?" Ye Qing's voice carried a hint of self-mockery, "I just don't want to see another pitiful wretch manipulated by fate die so miserably." She turned her head, a complex light flickering in those frost-cold eyes, "That agreement from the beginning was a backup plan I left for myself—I want to see with my own eyes if there's any way to break this so-called Heavenly Eye."

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughed—that smile was格外诡异 in the current desperate situation, yet carried an令人心悸的锋芒. His right hand quietly reached into his embrace, fingertips touching that jade slip that had been dormant in his Mental Sea—Mo Xiansheng's last hidden card. He knew that unless it was absolutely necessary, this card must never be revealed, but now, he needed to buy himself time to think. The Heavenly Eye wanted to watch a show? Then let it watch its fill.

choice.prompt: Faced with the truth revealed by Ye Qing and the oppression of the Heavenly Eye, Chen Ji needed to reevaluate the nature of this alliance. How should he choose?

choices.text: Be frank and form an alliance to resist together
choices.description: Since we're all chess pieces, we might as well work together to overturn the chessboard. Confess partial truths to Ye Qing, exchanging them for genuine trust and cooperation.
choices.visible_cost: Exposing some of your hidden cards may cause you to lose intelligence advantages
choices.visible_reward: Gain Ye Qing's complete trust, unlock the prerequisite conditions for "Shared Destiny"
choices.risk_hint: Whether Ye Qing is trustworthy remains an unknown

dialogue.content: "Since we're all pitiful wretches manipulated by fate," Chen Ji slowly spoke, his voice low yet carrying a resolve, "then let's simply overturn this chessboard. I can tell you the entire truth about the Tianji Record—as an exchange, between you and me, it's no longer mutual exploitation, but a true alliance. Weal and woe we share, life and death we face together."

Ye Qing froze for a moment, a disbelief flickering through those frost-cold eyes. She stared at Chen Ji for a long time, as if distinguishing the truth or falsehood in his words. Finally, she gently nodded, the corner of her lips drawing a bitter arc: "Fine... I'll trust you this once. But if you dare deceive me, even if Heaven doesn't kill you, I will take your life myself."

choices.memory_label: 与夜清达成真正的信任同盟

choices.text: Maintain distance and continue to probe
choices.description: The truth is too shocking; more time is needed to judge the situation. Continue to maintain superficial cooperative relations while secretly observing Ye Qing's true intentions.
choices.visible_cost: May miss the opportunity to establish a true alliance
choices.visible_reward: Maintain informational advantage, do not reveal our trump card
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye may seize the opportunity to strike

dialogue.content: "Interesting," Chen Ji's voice returned to its usual languidness, as if the earlier tremor had never occurred. "I never expected the Demonic Path Saintess to have such a tortuous past. However—" He stepped back, reopening the distance between them. "Our agreement remains valid, but what I want to know more is—what else haven't you told me? After all… those trapped in the same net aren't necessarily allies."

A flicker of imperceptible disappointment passed through Ye Qing's eyes, only to be swiftly replaced by cold indifference. She snorted lightly as the blood-colored barrier reformed: "Suit yourself. Whether you believe me is your own concern. But now—" She raised her head, fixing her gaze on that towering vertical pupil. "We have a more important enemy to face."

choices.memory_label: 与夜清保持距离，继续观望

choices.text: Seize the momentum to counterattack, drive back the Heavenly Eye
choices.description: Exploit the Heavenly Eye's attention toward Ye Qing's agreement by actively casting out bait, attempting to create an opening in this desperate situation.
choices.visible_cost: The existence of the Tianji Record Fragment may be exposed, drawing greater covetous attention
choices.visible_reward: Temporarily repel the Heavenly Will's projection, seize a moment to catch our breath
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye will not be easily fooled

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly stepped forward, directly confronting that vertical pupil, a derisive curve forming at the corner of his mouth: "Wanting to be Heaven's lackey also requires having the qualifications." His voice was not loud, yet each word cut like a blade. "You are merely a fragmented consciousness parasitic on the Tianji Record—how many inheritors have died across the generations, you know better than I. No rush? If this kid dies, you may not gain any benefit either."

That vertical pupil contracted abruptly, a boundless killing intent threatening to crush Chen Ji to pieces. Yet just then, Ye Qing spoke opportunely: "He's right. If you kill him now, my agreement activates automatically—in that case, with the Tianji Record in my hands, are you planning to continue as a disembodied fragment, or risk counterattack to seize it?"

choices.memory_label: 与夜清配合逼退天道之眼

text.content: Chen Ji and Ye Qing exchanged a glance, no superfluous words needed—the two had already reached some unspoken understanding. The Heavenly Eye's vertical pupil slowly rotated in the void, as if weighing pros and cons. That suffocating pressure gradually receded, but Chen Ji knew this was merely temporary—the Heavenly Eye never made pointless probes. It was waiting for a better moment. And he, too, needed that time to lay his plans.

"Interesting." That aged voice resounded again, yet now carried an undertone of profound implication. "Since you wish to play, this one will accompany you through this game. However—" The vertical pupil surged closer, its depths reflecting the images of Chen Ji and Ye Qing. "Every chess game reaches its conclusion—don't say this one didn't warn you when that moment arrives." As the voice fell, that projection of will receded like an ebbing tide, leaving only the slowly healing rift in the void and the eerie lingering sensations that permeated the surroundings.

The spirit pearl at the Dragon Vein Core once again emanated soft golden radiance, as if that breathtaking scene had been nothing more than an illusion. Chen Ji stood in place, gazing at that gradually vanishing purple vertical pupil, yet his heart was icy cold. The Heavenly Eye… this name, he had encountered countless times in the fragmented information left by Mo Xiansheng, yet never imagined he would one day confront it directly. What chilled him even more was—it seemed to have been waiting for him all along, watching to see how far this ant could struggle.

Ye Qing withdrew her blood-colored barrier, turning to face Chen Ji. Her complexion was deathly pale, a trace of blood even seeping from the corner of her lips—the earlier barrier had clearly exhausted most of her vital energy. Yet her gaze remained sharp as a blade, without a hint of retreat. "The feigned death plan…" she slowly began, her voice hoarse yet carrying a thread of resolve. "I agree to participate. But there is one condition."

choice.prompt: Ye Qing's condition will become the key to changing the situation. How should Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: Ye Qing's sacrifice just now is proof enough of her sincerity. Any bargaining at this moment would be foolish.
choices.visible_reward: Gain Ye Qing's full cooperation, greatly increasing the success rate of the feigned death plan
choices.risk_hint: The condition's content is unknown, there may be hidden risks

dialogue.content: "Say it." Chen Ji didn't hesitate in the slightest, directly interrupting the condition she was about to state. "Just now you risked your life to shield me—this kindness I remember. Whatever the condition, as long as I can accomplish it, I agree without exception." His tone was calm, yet carried an unshakeable certainty, as if this wasn't a life-or-death decision, but merely issuing an ordinary command.

Ye Qing was stunned, seemingly not having expected him to agree so readily. After a moment of silence, she spoke: "The condition is simple—if the plan fails and I die before you, you must personally cremate me, leaving no trace." Her voice was terrifyingly calm. "I refuse to let my corpse become another piece for Heaven to exploit."

choices.memory_label: 答应夜清条件，建立生死托付关系

choices.text: First clarify the conditions before deciding
choices.description: Even trusting Ye Qing, all details must be clearly understood. Blind agreement may bring unforeseen consequences.
choices.visible_cost: might appear as not trusting Ye Qing enough
choices.visible_reward: retain some initiative to avoid falling into unknown traps
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing might develop doubts as a result

dialogue.content: "Wait." Chen Ji raised his hand to interrupt her, his expression turning serious. "I trust you, but that doesn't mean I'll blindly agree to everything. Tell me, what are your conditions?" His gaze fixed on Ye Qing's eyes, as if trying to pierce through all her secrets. "It's not that I don't trust you, but... since we're going to cooperate, we should lay all our cards on the table."

Ye Qing sighed softly, a complex emotion flickering across her features: "You're more cautious than I imagined. Very well... my condition is this: if the plan fails and I die before you, you must personally burn my body, leaving no trace. I refuse to let my corpse become another pawn that Heavenly Dao can exploit."

choices.memory_label: 了解夜清条件后再做决定

choices.description: Since it's cooperation, it should be bidirectional. Propose your own conditions to ensure both parties have an escape route.
choices.visible_reward: establishing a more equal cooperative relationship with guarantees for both parties

dialogue.content: "Agreed." Chen Ji nodded crisply, then shifted his tone. "But I have one condition too—if the plan succeeds and I survive, I will take you away from the Holy Sect's control." His voice was low and resolute. "Both you and I are chess pieces manipulated by fate. If we're going to overturn the board, we should save everyone—including you."

Ye Qing's figure stiffened slightly, an incredulous expression flickering across those cold eyes. She stared at Chen Ji for a long time, as if discerning the truth in his words. Finally, she nodded gently, a bitter curve forming at the corner of her lips: "Fine... I trust you. But if you dare deceive me, even if Heavenly Dao doesn't kill you, I will take your life myself."

choices.memory_label: 与夜清达成双向保障约定

text.content: Ye Qing looked at Chen Ji's outstretched right hand,沉默了片刻，终于将手放入他的掌心。两人的手指交握在一起，一个冰凉如霜，一个温热如火——温度的差异仿佛也象征着他们各自的处境与命运。然而就在这一刻，陈机忽然感觉到掌心传来一阵刺痛，仿佛有什么东西正在从夜清的手中渗入他的识海。那是一道模糊的画面——漫天血雨中，一个年幼的女孩被黑袍人拖入深渊，而远处，一个瘦弱的身影正绝望地呼喊着什么。

dialogue.content: "This is a memory from my childhood." Ye Qing's voice was very light, yet carried an indescribable heaviness. "My real name isn't Ye Qing... that was given to me by the Holy Sect, like numbering a tool. My true name... even I have almost forgotten it." She gently pulled back her hand, her expression returning to its usual coldness. "Now you know my secrets. If you think the risk is too great, you can still back out now."

Chen Ji didn't speak, only gripped her hand again, this time even tighter. He thought of his sister Chen Nian—that child also taken by the Holy Sect, still missing to this day. If Master Chen Xuan hadn't saved him back then, would he too have become a pitiful wretch manipulated by fate? "Back out?" He laughed softly, yet his eyes held a profound depth. "In this life of mine, the one thing I never lack is the obsession to fight fate unto death. Since you dared to reveal your scars to me, what wouldn't I dare to accept?"

text.content: Ye Qing was stunned. For the first time, something complex appeared in those cold eyes—not gratitude, not trust, but a long-buried resonance. She recalled Chen Ji's performance before the Eye of Heavenly Dao, remembered how even facing a certain death situation he could still calmly lay out strategies, and suddenly understood why the Tianji Record had chosen him as its heir. This seemingly废物 of a youth was like her—a person pushed to the brink by fate yet still refusing to bow.

"Very well." Ye Qing's voice was soft, yet carried an unprecedented solemnity. "In that case, our pact... let us rewrite it. Not an agreement of mutual exploitation, but a true—" She paused, as if tasting this unfamiliar word. "Alliance." As her words fell, she extended her right hand, and a bizarre blood-colored mark appeared in her palm—the external manifestation of the restriction within her body. "This is the 'Soul-Devouring Mark' of my Holy Sect. Once branded, it means sharing life and death. I give it to you as... good faith."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji looked at that blood-colored mark without the slightest hesitation. He drew a cut across his own left palm with his finger, and as blood gushed forth, a trace of the Tianji Record Fragment's aura also leaked out. "I will leave you a copy of the Tianji Record's contract as well." His voice was calm. "From now on, there are no more secrets between us—at least not in the matter of opposing Heavenly Dao." The two marks met in the air, blood-red and golden light intertwining, forming a strange resonance. At the same time, Chen Ji felt his Heavenly Fate Value drain away once more, while the restriction within Ye Qing seemed to loosen slightly.

text.content: A low rumble suddenly came from the depths of the Dragon's Vein, as if some colossal being was awakening. Ye Qing frowned slightly, looking toward the Dragon's Vein's core: "The guardian beast of the Dragon's Vein has sensed us here..." She paused, and a solemn expression appeared on her pale face. "Time is running out; we must leave quickly. But before that—" She looked at Chen Ji, a complex light flickering in her eyes. "Su Qingyao is already on her way. How do you plan to deal with her?"

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's eyes flickered slightly, yet a meaningful smile curved his lips. "Su Qingyao... she's arriving at just the right time." His voice carried a hint of satisfaction at a successful scheme. "The feigned death plan needs a witness, and she... is the most suitable person." He glanced at Ye Qing, a trace of cunning flashing in his eyes. "Didn't you always want to know why I formed an alliance with the Holy Sect's Saint? You'll understand soon—the truth is that every move I make has more than one purpose."

text.content: Ye Qing looked at Chen Ji thoughtfully, then suddenly laughed softly—that smile carried both relief and helplessness: "I thought I was the one scheming against you, but now it seems... from the very beginning, I was the poor wretch being schemed against." She shook her head, yet held no hint of resentment. "Fine, since we're both determined to fight fate, having a meticulous strategist like you scouting the path ahead actually saves me a lot of worry."

The distant sword intent grew ever closer, and a biting chill filled the air. Chen Ji looked up toward the Tianqing Sect, his gaze flickering. Su Qingyao... that woman who had repeatedly approached the truth yet always had it dissolved. That existence he both wanted to push away yet had to use. If the feigned death plan succeeded, she would become the most crucial witness; if the plan failed... He closed his eyes briefly, pressing that trace of unease deep into his heart. The Tianji Record's prophecies never err. Since he had seen that path, there was no room for retreat.

"Let's go." Chen Ji收回目光，turned and walked in the direction opposite the sword intent. "This journey to the Dragon's Vein ends here. The chess game that follows has only just begun." Ye Qing didn't speak, only silently followed his footsteps. The two silhouettes disappeared into the mist of the Dragon's Vein's depths, leaving behind the gradually dissipating remnants of Heavenly Dao's will, and that increasingly close凌厉 sword light in the distance—Su Qingyao, carrying full of doubts and concerns, stepping into this chess game that had been arranged long ago.
